title: Ronald Moultrie scrubbed Battelle board role from LinkedIn

tellings.quote: Ronald Moltry uh you know the basically created the opaces under which Arrow was created also uh was board director of Battel Memorial Institute and and deleted that off his LinkedIn.

plain: Ronald Moultrie, a former top Pentagon intelligence official under whose authority AARO, the Pentagon's current office for investigating UFO reports, was set up, is said to have also sat on the board of the Battelle Memorial Institute, a large private research organisation that works for the government, and to have deleted that role from his LinkedIn profile. The online researcher UAPGerb points this out to Michels from his own digging, naming no other source than the profile itself. He raises it because it would tie the man behind the official investigation to a contractor some suspect of secret work.
